comments.text:
Imagine eating breakfast in Europe and taking a ferry to Asia for work. In Istanbul, that's just a normal morning. In this Turkey documentary, we went from a city hidden 280 feet underground to tea shops where strangers become friends 🫖 But behind that famous hospitality, real life in Turkey comes with a price most visitors never notice…
Tell us your comments, and subscribe if you'd like to keep traveling with us 🌍 #Turkey #TurkeyDocumentary #Istanbul
